{
"meetingId": "199",
"tickets": [
{
"templateId": "ef69e24e-b352-50b8-81a8-9d4035bd97bf",
"title": "Coordinate business sale planning handoff",
"text": "Briefly document the expected sale structure, key advisors involved, estimated liquidity timing, tax issues to review, and next advisory handoff steps with Serena Cloudpuddle’s CPA Jonah Wrenpuddle and attorney Celia Nettlewhisk. Provide the coordinated recommendations to Serena by 2024-08-02.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2024-08-02",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Serena asked for direct coordination with Jonah and Celia on sale structure, liquidity timing, escrow terms, and tax planning before recommendations on staging proceeds; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-08-02."
},
{
"templateId": "d71226e6-275a-5a53-88b4-57b55eccb19c",
"title": "Liquidity Reserve Snapshot",
"text": "Prepare a cash reserve estimate for Serena Cloudpuddle that covers her household spending of $22,000 per month, anticipated tax liabilities, mortgage payments on the $740,000 loan, upcoming school costs for Lila Cloudpuddle and support for her mother, and present the proposal by 2024-08-09.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2024-08-09",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "The income transition and temporary consulting arrangement led to an agreed 2024-08-09 follow-up to size a cash reserve for spending, estimated taxes, mortgage payments, school costs, and support for Serena’s mother."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Obtain post‑closing tax estimate",
"text": "Obtain the post‑closing tax estimate from Serena Cloudpuddle’s CPA Jonah Wrenpuddle and complete the tax coordination for her sale proceeds by 2024-08-16.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2024-08-16",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Estimated tax coordination remains needed by 2024-08-16 because the CPA expects a near-term post-closing estimate, but no amount was available."
},
{
"templateId": null,
"title": "Gather executed sale documentation",
"text": "Collect the executed purchase agreement, escrow schedule, consulting agreement, and wire‑instruction evidence for Serena Cloudpuddle’s sale and deliver the complete set by 2024-07-31.",
"priority": null,
"dueDate": "2024-07-31",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [],
"evidence": "Sale documentation remains needed by 2024-07-31 because only a summary term sheet was available, not the executed purchase agreement, escrow schedule, consulting agreement, or wire instruction evidence."
},
{
"templateId": "14e5989f-674d-5715-91ad-e38bb23e715b",
"title": "Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps",
"text": "Request Serena Cloudpuddle's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation. Review the current trust, powers of attorney, health care directives, and beneficiary records and summarize any gaps by 2024-08-23.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": "2024-08-23",
"assigneeId": null,
"subTasks": [
{
"title": "Request and log estate documents",
"text": "Send the standard document request checklist to Serena Cloudpuddle and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": "dc27a56a-9f8e-5909-959b-cf89e9c02e33"
},
{
"title": "Review completeness and role information",
"text": "Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": "a7eb678b-bf5e-50fc-b01b-eeb80d99a3e0"
},
{
"title": "Prepare advisor gap summary",
"text": "Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.",
"priority": "medium",
"dueDate": null,
"assigneeId": "91e6fcb2-95ab-5fbf-b81c-989b1748ccb3"
}
],
"evidence": "Evan noted older estate-document drafts and no current signed trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, or beneficiary records after the business value change; an estate document review was agreed for 2024-08-23."
}
]
}
